native_install_mechanism: Claude Code plugin SessionStart hook plus CLAUDE.md fallback
supported_runtime_versions: Claude Code plugin runtime and Claude surfaces that read CLAUDE.md project memory
install: Install .claude-plugin/plugin.json; the SessionStart hook injects BOOTSTRAP.md. CLAUDE.md remains the T2 fallback.
update: Update the plugin, Kernel, and hook files in the repository.
uninstall: Remove the Claude plugin registration and CLAUDE.md fallback. No shell profile is modified.
rollback: Restore the previously tagged plugin, hook, Kernel, and CLAUDE.md files.
limitations: Surfaces without plugin hooks degrade to CLAUDE.md T2 or manual activation and must record that lower tier.
deprecation: Designed adapter; runtime activation evidence is pending.
